translationRepairs: The powers resented Prince Duan's conduct and were determined on retaliation.
The foreign powers were displeased with what Prince Duan and his circle had done; furious, he sought revenge.

s0022 has 各國不慊載漪等所為，漪恚甚，圖報復: the powers were displeased with Prince Duan and his circle, but 漪恚甚，圖報復 makes Prince Duan the one furious and plotting revenge. The before wrongly attributes retaliation to the powers; the proposed after restores the correct agent and also preserves 載漪等.
The Empress Dowager believed them still more and put Gang Yi and Zaiyi in command, treating the Boxers as the equal of regular troops.
The Empress Dowager believed them still more and put Gang Yi and Zai Xun in command, treating the Boxers as the equal of regular troops.
s0048 orders 剛毅、載勳 to command the Boxers. 載勳 is Zai Xun (Prince Zhuang), distinct from 載漪 (Zaiyi / Prince Duan) in the preceding sentence. Idiomatic 'Zaiyi' misnames him; 'Zai Xun' is correct.
When the Boxer rising erupted, Ying Nian and Zai Lan were appointed deputies to Zaiyi and Gang Yi in commanding the movement.
When the Boxer rising erupted, Ying Nian and Zai Lan were appointed deputies to Zai Xun and Gang Yi in commanding the movement.
s0110 has 以英年、載瀾副載勳、剛毅統之: Ying Nian and Zai Lan were deputies to 載勳 (Zai Xun) and Gang Yi. Replacing 'Zaiyi' with 'Zai Xun' corrects the misread name without other change.
Zaiyi and his allies paraded through the streets recruiting militia to attack the legations; Ying Nian could not stop them, and the rebels grew bolder, slaughtering officials and civilians at will.
Zai Xun and his allies posted notices recruiting militia to attack the legations; Ying Nian could not stop them, and the rebels grew bolder, slaughtering officials and civilians at will.
s0111 begins 載勳等出示，招致義民助攻使館. The subject is Zai Xun and others, not Zaiyi, and 出示 means posting notices, not parading through the streets. The proposed after corrects both the name and the action.
The Empress Dowager believed them all the more and therefore ordered Gang Yi and Zaiyi to command them, ranking them with the regular army.
The Empress Dowager believed them all the more and therefore ordered Gang Yi and Zai Xun to command them, ranking them with the regular army.
Same focus unit as r0002: literal also renders 載勳 as Zaiyi. Replacing with Zai Xun matches 剛毅、載勳統之.
When Xu Tong was thereafter ordered to oversee [the heir], they became still closer to Prince Duan.
When Xu Tong was thereafter ordered to oversee [the heir], he became still closer to Prince Duan.
s0021 has 既而桐被命照料，益親載漪: the subject of 益親 is singular 桐 (Xu Tong). Literal 'they became' invents a plural subject; 'he became' is accurate.
When the Boxer disturbance broke out, Ying Nian and Zai Lan were made deputies to Zaiyi and Gang Yi to command them.
When the Boxer disturbance broke out, Ying Nian and Zai Lan were made deputies to Zai Xun and Gang Yi to command them.
Same Chinese as r0003: 副載勳、剛毅. Literal 'Zaiyi' is the wrong prince; 'Zai Xun' correctly romanizes 載勳.

Zaiyi and others went out and summoned righteous people to assist in attacking the legations; Ying Nian could not stop them, and the bandits grew still more arrogant, killing officials and commoners at will.

Zai Xun and others posted notices and summoned righteous people to assist in attacking the legations; Ying Nian could not stop them, and the bandits grew still more arrogant, killing officials and commoners at will.
s0111 subject is 載勳等, so Zai Xun is right, but the proposed after still renders 出示 as 'went out.' 出示 means posting or issuing notices; revise to keep the name fix and restore that sense alongside 招致.
